devdoc.details: Standalone router, NOT a Uniswap hook. Standard ERC20 and native currency only. Deposits are attributed immediately. A later split change cannot rewrite claims.

allocateSurplus(address).details: Attribution occurs NOW under the current split, not at transfer time. Integrations must use depositToken/depositNative for historical attribution.

depositConverted((address,uint256,addres.details: Configure a converter to use a DEX route; no conversion market is assumed.

allocateSurplus(address).notice: Attribute uncredited direct ERC20 transfers / forced native transfers.

claim(address,uint256,address).notice: Withdraw only the caller's own earned funds to any chosen destination.

claimConverted((address,uint256,address,.notice: The beneficiary chooses an output token and explicit conversion constraints.

claimFor(address,address).notice: Permissionless automation may pay a beneficiary at their own address.

commitSplit().notice: Irrevocably freeze future deposit allocation; existing claims were already immutable.

depositConverted((address,uint256,addres.notice: Convert a new payment before splitting. The payer supplies all input.

userdoc.notice: Owner-defined fee allocation with earned, independently withdrawable claims.
